verdict.rationale: PayPal Subscriptions docs list "Automate payment recovery for failed payments" as a supported customization, so automatic recovery of failed subscription payments is claimed. The evidence is only a one-line mention, and nothing describes how retries are scheduled or configured, any smart dunning logic, or customer-facing recovery emails for subscriptions. The automatic payment reminders that are documented apply to invoices, not subscriptions. Missing for 10: documented retry schedule/configuration, smart or adaptive dunning logic, subscription recovery email notifications, independent or hands-on corroboration.
